item.case_name: Full fiction short, 30 s, 16:9, text only
item.title: Walk Anyway, the short film

turns.text:
Make a 30-second 16:9 short film called Walk Anyway from this description. There are no reference images.

Characters: a tall woman with a silver bob, a red raincoat and yellow boots. An older man with a grey beard, a green coat and a black umbrella. Keep both looking the same in every shot.

Start on a title card for 2 seconds: black background, white text "WALK ANYWAY".

Then four shots, in this order:
1. Night, rain. The woman waits alone at a bus stop.
2. The man walks up with his umbrella and stops beside her.
3. Close on both of them. He says out loud: "You came back." She smiles.
4. They walk away together under the umbrella, seen from behind.

End on the same title card for 2 seconds, so the video loops back to its first frame.

Sound: rain, and his one line. No music and no narrator. Give me one finished video file.

calls.name: get_prompting_guide
calls.output:
# ltx — prompting & settings guide

- **Prompting style:** natural_language
- **Negative prompt:** supported
- **Prompt weights** (e.g. `(word:1.2)`): not honored
- **Loader:** CheckpointLoaderSimple (or UNETLoader for the diffusion_model build)

## Recommended settings

| steps | cfg | sampler | scheduler | resolution |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 30 | 3 | euler | normal | 768x512 |

## Tips

- LTX-Video rewards LONG, very detailed prompts — describe subject, background, lighting, and especially camera motion in one flowing paragraph.
- It supports a negative prompt; a low-to-moderate cfg (~3) keeps motion coherent.
- Distilled LTX variants run far fewer steps (≈8) — check whether the checkpoint is the distilled build before defaulting to 30.

## Common mistakes

- Don't write a short tag prompt — LTX produces washed-out or static clips without a rich descriptive paragraph.
- Don't use a high CFG; LTX degrades above ~4.

## Example prompt

> A close-up of a steaming cup of coffee on a windowsill as raindrops slide down the glass behind it; the camera slowly pushes in while soft grey daylight shifts across the scene, gentle wisps of steam curling upward.

_meta.title: Scene 1 — Alone at the bus stop — 6 seconds

inputs.text:
01   NIGHT. RAIN.

A tall woman waits alone at a bus stop.
Silver bob. Red raincoat. Yellow boots.

Rain falls on the empty street.

02   THE SAME BUS STOP.

An older man walks up and stops beside her.
Grey beard. Green coat. Black umbrella.

He holds the umbrella over them both.

03   CLOSE ON BOTH, UNDER THE UMBRELLA.

                 THE MAN
              "You came back."

She smiles. The rain continues.

04   FROM BEHIND.

They walk away together under one umbrella.
Her red raincoat. His green coat.
Yellow boots cross the shining pavement.

The rain keeps falling.
